Pricing

The lowest GPU prices in the market, published.

SaladCloud gives you on-demand access to thousands of RTX-class GPUs, with live supply visible alongside published per-second pricing. Four priority tiers let you balance availability, reliability, and cost. vCPU and RAM are included with every GPU.

Priority

Final cost is determined by the seconds each instance spends in the running state. Allocation, download, and cold start are free. Higher priority tiers are protected from preemption by other workloads; Lowest is the lowest cost and the most interruptible.

Priority tiers

Pay for the reliability you need.

High

Never preempted by other workloads. Still subject to node disconnection; SCE reallocates automatically.

Medium and Low

May be preempted by higher-priority groups. Minimum run before reallocation is roughly 30 minutes.

Lowest (Batch)

The lowest-cost tier. Ideal for retryable batch work and stateless inference behind a queue. CPU-only groups run here.

FAQ

Simple and transparent. No surprises.

Do I pay for cold boot time?

No. You pay only for time the hardware is running your application. Allocation, image download, and container start are free.

When do charges start and stop?

Billing is per second while an instance is in the running state. It stops the moment the instance stops, is reallocated, or is preempted.

Do you offer volume discounts?

Yes, for deployments above 100 GPUs, long-running jobs, and committed contracts. Fill out the sales form and we'll price your workload.

Is there a free trial?

No. SaladCloud and the Transcription API are pay-as-you-go with no minimum commitment, so you can start with a small, low-cost test before scaling.

How can prices be this low?

Community Cloud runs on GPUs that already exist in homes and small businesses worldwide. Owners are paid for idle time, and a competitive marketplace keeps prices near the cost of electricity rather than the cost of a data center.
